items.title: 2 Restaurant Stocks to Consider Right Now and 1 Facing Headwinds
items.summary: From fast food to fine dining, restaurants play a vital societal role. But the side dish is that they’re quite difficult to operate because high inventory and labor costs generally lead to thin margins at the store level. This leaves little room for error if demand dries up, and it seems like the market has some reservations as the industry’s returns were flat over the past six months while the S&P 500 was up 16.4%.
